name: moving-border

frames.best_why: Frame 6 catches a clear blue glow running along the bottom-right rim with the whole button in view.

tagline: A blue spark runs around the rim of a dark pill-shaped button.
summary: A pill button on a translucent dark slate fill with a white label. A small blue glow travels the full perimeter on a loop, so the edge is always lit in one moving spot.
appearance: A rounded pill button on black, filled in a translucent dark slate with a faint darker border and a white medium-weight label reading Moving Border. A soft blue highlight glows on one part of the rim at a time.
behaviour: A blue radial glow circles the entire perimeter continuously, completing a lap roughly every three seconds, so the bright spot travels along the rim without a pause. The fill and label never move.
search_phrases: button with light running around its edge
glowing ring that circles a button
neon light circling a pill button
call to action with a moving glow
button rim lit up and rotating
use_when: A primary button should keep drawing the eye with a slow glowing rim.
avoid_when: You need a strong focus state, or the glow must stop for motion-sensitive users.
customise: children is the label, and borderRadius, as, containerClassName, borderClassName and duration are props. The blue glow colour and the 30% corner radii are fixed in the source.
weight_why: One SVG rect path sampled every frame to move a single small glow.

a11y.note: It is a real button with a text label, but there is no visible focus ring and the glow never stops for reduced-motion.

issues: The glow is faint against the dark pill, so the effect is easy to miss at a glance.
No visible focus ring, and the loop never stops for reduced-motion.
polish_why: Smooth travelling glow on a clean pill; a faint rim and missing focus ring are small flaws.
title: Moving Border Button
